description: Road maintenance and repairs is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council. Annual gross capital expenditure and net revenue expenditure on road maintenance and repairs on roads within Calderdale. The data is taken from the annual Capital Outturn and Revenue Outturn returns. The full returns can be found on the GOV.UK website at: Local authority capital expenditure, receipts and financing. Local authority revenue expenditure and financing. Coverage: Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council. The portal files it under the publisher Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, DOCX, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
